MTT-R0101.seoTitle: Custom Perfume Lift-Off Lid Box | Gloss & Silver Foil
MTT-R0101.seoDescription: Custom perfume lid-and-base packaging with a separate cap, fitted bottle cavity and gloss finish. Compare opening, insert fit and sample requirements.
answer: A separate-lid rigid box for a single perfume bottle, with a gloss-printed wrap and silver foil accents. The cap lifts completely away from the base; it is not a hinged magnetic box.
适合单瓶香水展示的天地盖硬盒，采用亮膜印刷裱纸与银色烫箔。上盖与底盒完全分离，不是磁吸翻盖。
selection: Choose this when you want an uninterrupted bottle reveal and a removable lid. If the lid must stay attached during use, compare a book-style box instead. A corrugated outer pack may still be needed for parcel delivery.
希望完整展示瓶器、上盖可独立取下时可选此款。若要求盖子保持连接，应比较书型盒；快递运输仍可能需要外层瓦楞包装。
review: Measure the filled bottle with its cap fitted, including the widest decoration, and provide weight. Review cavity support, finger access, lid removal and cap clearance together. Confirm foil detail and gloss appearance on the actual wrapping paper.
提供装好瓶盖后的最大外形尺寸、装液重量及装饰突出部位。一起检查内托支撑、手指取放、提盖松紧与瓶盖净空，并以实际裱纸确认烫箔和亮膜效果。

MTT-R0103.seoTitle: Custom Magnetic Skincare Gift Box | Textured Wrap
MTT-R0103.seoDescription: Plan a magnetic skincare gift box with one jar and two bottle positions. Review linen-textured wrap, debossing, removal access and closure clearance.
answer: A hinged rigid skincare set box with a jar position beside two bottle positions. Linen-textured wrap and a debossed border give a tactile surface rather than a high-gloss finish.
带铰接盖的护肤套装硬盒，内托为一罐两瓶布局；细麻纹裱纸与压凹边框强调触感。
selection: Use this for a set that opens as one presentation. Choose a separate carton for each item if units need independent retail sale; the set box and individual cartons can share artwork without sharing the same construction.
适合一次打开展示整套产品。如每件需要独立零售，可为单品另配卡纸盒；套盒和单品盒可共用视觉元素，但结构应分别确认。
review: Send each jar and bottle size with closures fitted and the loaded set weight. Check that the lid and magnet area clear the tallest item. Test finger access and deboss definition on the selected textured wrap.
提供每个瓶罐装好盖后的尺寸及整套重量。检查盖面、磁吸位置与最高产品的间隙，并测试取放空间和纹理纸上的压凹清晰度。

MTT-R0202.seoTitle: Custom Coffee Tasting Drawer Gift Box | Four Compartments
MTT-R0202.seoDescription: Explore a four-compartment coffee tasting drawer box for sealed pouches, with printed wrap, a sliding tray and coordinated cards or ribbon.
answer: A rigid sleeve and sliding tray organize four sealed coffee pouches into a tasting set. The gloss-printed wrap creates a bright presentation; the paper box does not replace the coffee pouch barrier.
硬质外套与抽屉内匣组成四格咖啡品鉴套盒，亮膜印刷形成鲜明展示；纸盒不能替代咖啡密封袋的阻隔功能。
selection: Choose a drawer for a gradual reveal and separate tasting positions. If empty-pack shipping volume is the priority, compare a folding carton. Measure the actual sealed pouch rather than using its nominal fill weight as a size.
抽屉适合渐进式开箱与分格展示。若优先降低空包装体积，可比较折叠卡纸盒；尺寸应测量封口后的实际包装袋，不能从净含量推算。
review: Include pouch seams and any valve in measurements. Check tray movement with all four pouches loaded, removal access and the pull attachment. Confirm whether tasting cards sit above the products or in a separate pocket.
测量时包含封边及排气阀。装满四袋后测试抽拉、取放和拉带连接，并确认品鉴卡放在产品上方还是另设卡位。

MTT-R0303.seoTitle: Custom Collagen Gift Set Box | Matte & Spot UV
MTT-R0303.seoDescription: Custom collagen set packaging with a tub well and sachet compartment. Review magnetic opening, matte wrap, selective gloss UV and the packed sample.
answer: A magnetic book-style box groups a sealed tub and sachets. Matte lamination with selective gloss UV creates contrast in the printed surface without changing the rigid opening structure.
磁吸书型盒组合展示密封罐和小袋装产品；哑膜与局部亮 UV 形成表面反差，开合结构仍为硬质翻盖。
selection: Choose this for a coordinated routine or gift set. For individual refills, a separate folding carton may be more appropriate. The outer gift box does not establish shelf life or replace the product’s sealed primary pack.
适合组合使用套装或赠礼。独立补充装可考虑卡纸盒；外层礼盒不能证明保质期，也不能替代产品密封内包装。
review: Provide the tub diameter and height, sachet stack size and full set weight. Check the lid over the tub, sachet retrieval and UV alignment using a separate finish mask. Keep batch information readable and accessible on the sealed products.
提供罐体直径、高度、小袋堆叠尺寸和整套重量。检查罐顶净空、小袋取放，并用独立工艺图层确认 UV 位置；保留内装产品批次信息的可读性与查看方式。

MTT-R0401.seoTitle: Custom Ring Keepsake Box | Cloth Wrap & Lift-Off Lid
MTT-R0401.seoDescription: Cloth-wrapped ring keepsake packaging with a removable lid and fabric-lined ring slit. Review ring fit, lid clearance and foil on the chosen cloth.
answer: A small rigid lid-and-base keepsake box with bookcloth wrap and a fabric-lined ring slit. The silver motif is a surface finish; the lid is fully removable.
小型天地盖收藏盒，外覆装帧布、内设织物衬里的戒指插槽；银色图案为表面工艺，上盖可完全取下。
selection: Choose this for a ring presentation with a textile feel. A hinged presentation box is a different opening option. Do not assume the lining is anti-tarnish or suitable for every metal and gemstone without material review.
适合强调织物触感的戒指展示。若需要连体开合，可另选翻盖结构；未经材料核实，不应认定内衬具备防氧化性能或适用于所有金属与宝石。
review: Provide band width, ring size and the maximum setting height. Test insertion and removal without snagging, lid clearance over the stone and foil readability across the cloth texture.
提供戒圈尺寸、戒臂宽度及镶嵌部位最大高度。测试插取是否勾挂、宝石上方净空，以及布纹上的烫箔清晰度。

MTT-R0507.seoTitle: Custom Hexagonal Sweets Gift Box | Six Compartments
MTT-R0507.seoDescription: Hexagonal rigid gift packaging for individually wrapped sweets, with six compartments, dyed paper and gold foil. Review fit and separate-lid alignment.
answer: A six-sided rigid base and matching removable cap create a festival gift format with six wrapped-sweet compartments. The polygon is structural, not a rectangular box printed to look hexagonal.
六边形硬质底盒配独立六边形上盖，内设六格独立包装糖点位置；外形来自真实多边结构，而非矩形盒上的印刷装饰。
selection: Choose this when a distinctive outline matters more than rectangular packing efficiency. Compare a rectangular gift box if shelf or master-carton space is tight. Plan around individually wrapped contents unless the intended food-contact materials are separately approved.
适合重视独特轮廓的节日礼赠。若货架或外箱空间紧张，可比较矩形礼盒。优先按独立包装内容物规划；直接接触食品的材料须另行确认。
review: Send wrapped-piece sizes and the proposed arrangement. Confirm the internal usable area, corner joints, cap alignment and removal of every piece. Review the foil registration and any card or ribbon with the assembled sample.
提供包好后每件尺寸及排列方式。确认内部可用空间、转角接缝、上盖对位及每格取放，并在组装样品上核对烫箔、卡片和丝带。

MTT-C0104.seoTitle: Custom Skincare Crash-Lock Carton | Printed Kraft
MTT-C0104.seoDescription: Printed kraft skincare carton with a pre-glued crash-lock base, tuck top and paperboard support. Review bottle sizes, base assembly and print opacity.
answer: A kraft paperboard carton with a pre-glued crash-lock bottom and tuck top. Folded paperboard support separates the skincare pair; this is a folding carton, not a rigid magnetic gift box.
牛皮卡纸盒采用预糊自动扣底与上插口结构，折叠纸托分隔两件护肤品；属于卡纸折叠盒，不是磁吸精品硬盒。
selection: Choose this when a folding retail pack and bottom assembly are important. The base is not a guarantee of load capacity. For a heavier glass pair, compare the complete support and shipping pack before selecting the board.
适合重视折叠零售包装和扣底组装的项目。扣底结构不等于承重保证；较重玻璃瓶组合应先评估完整支撑与运输包装，再确定纸板。
review: Provide both assembled bottle sizes and filled weights. Check base engagement with the contents loaded, bottle separation and top-flap clearance. Approve opaque colours on actual kraft, since its base colour affects the print.
提供两瓶装配后尺寸与装液重量。装入产品后检查扣底到位、瓶间隔离及顶舌净空；牛皮纸底色会影响印色，应确认实纸上的遮盖色效果。

MTT-C0112.seoTitle: Custom Macaron Window Carton | Sealed Product Display
MTT-C0112.seoDescription: Window tuck carton for sealed macarons with paperboard support and matte/spot-UV print. Review tray dimensions, window attachment and food-pack scope.
answer: A white paperboard tuck carton shows sealed macarons through a small film window. The tuck tongue and dust flaps close the top; the window is separate from the sealed food pack inside.
白卡插口盒通过透明膜窗口展示密封包装马卡龙；顶部由插舌与防尘翼关闭，外盒窗口与内部食品密封包装是不同部件。
selection: Choose this when the actual product should be visible on the shelf. Use an enclosed carton if light exposure or concealment is a concern. Do not infer food-contact suitability or shelf life from the window image.
适合需要在货架上看见实物的产品。若需要遮光或隐藏内容物，可选择封闭盒。不能从开窗图片推断食品接触适用性或保质期。
review: Measure the sealed tray, including flange and lid, and state storage conditions and destination. Check window adhesion, remaining board border and product movement. Review the material documentation for the intended use rather than relying on a generic “food grade” label.
测量密封托盘的边沿与盖子，说明储存条件和目的地。检查贴窗牢固度、窗口周围纸框及产品移动；按预期用途确认材料文件，不能只看泛泛的“食品级”字样。

MTT-C0128.seoTitle: Custom Festive Pillow Carton | Printed Kraft Gift Pack
MTT-C0128.seoDescription: Curved pillow carton for wrapped confectionery with opaque printing on kraft. Review usable volume, crescent end closures and optional gift accessories.
answer: A curved kraft pillow carton with overlapping crescent end flaps holds wrapped confectionery. It opens at a curved end and has no rigid tray or magnetic hinge.
弧形牛皮卡纸枕形盒采用重叠月牙端翼闭合，用于独立包装糖果；从弧形端部打开，没有硬质内匣或磁吸铰接盖。
selection: Choose this for a compact festive handout with a distinctive silhouette. Compare a compartmented rigid box when fragile pieces need separate positions. The curved ends reduce usable space relative to the outer outline.
适合外形鲜明的小型节庆赠礼。易碎内容物若需逐格定位，可比较分格硬盒；弧形端部会减少外轮廓以内的有效容积。
review: Send wrapped-piece sizes, count and total weight. Load the sample to confirm the ends close without crushing products or springing open. Keep key artwork clear of curved folds and decide how the optional card or ribbon is attached.
提供单件包装尺寸、数量和总重。装样后检查端翼是否挤压产品或弹开；重点图文避开弧形折线，并确认可选卡片、丝带的固定方式。

MTT-E0103.seoTitle: Custom Perfume Corrugated Mailer | Printed Roll-End Box
MTT-E0103.seoDescription: Printed corrugated perfume mailer with a rear-hinged lid and fitted paper support. Review bottle retention, closures and the complete transit sample.
answer: A white-lined corrugated roll-end mailer with a rear-hinged lid, side wings and paper support. This is shipping-oriented corrugated construction, distinct from a wrapped rigid book box.
白面瓦楞飞机盒带后连盖、侧插翼与纸质支撑，属于面向运输的瓦楞结构，与裱糊硬质书型盒不同。
selection: Choose this for a branded parcel format, subject to a loaded-pack review. A bottle insert alone does not prove transit protection. A rigid gift box can be an inner presentation layer if the complete mailer is resized around it.
适合品牌化包裹场景，但需评估装实物后的完整包装。仅有瓶托不能证明运输保护；如内配精品礼盒，应围绕礼盒重新确定外层飞机盒尺寸。
review: Provide the filled bottle weight, cap geometry and whether a retail box sits inside. Check restraint, closure, flute direction and packed dimensions. Agree transport testing and carrier acceptance separately for the actual product and route.
提供装液重量、瓶盖形状及是否内含零售盒。检查限位、闭合、楞向和装箱尺寸；运输测试及承运要求需按实际产品与线路单独确认。

MTT-E0104.seoTitle: Custom Skincare Shipping Carton | Four-Flap Corrugated
MTT-E0104.seoDescription: Kraft corrugated shipping carton for skincare sets with four top flaps and paper support. Specify packed weight, dividers, sealing and delivery route.
answer: A kraft-lined corrugated carton closes with two short inner flaps and two long outer flaps. Two-colour printing identifies the pack; paper support is developed around the loaded skincare set.
牛皮面瓦楞箱采用两片短内摇盖和两片长外摇盖闭合，以双色印刷识别包装，纸支撑按实际护肤套装设计。
selection: Choose this for a transport outer pack, not for a magnetic gift-box opening. If the customer receives a presentation box inside, measure that finished box as part of the shipment and keep the two layers distinct in the quote.
适合作为运输外包装，不属于磁吸礼盒开箱方式。若内部含展示礼盒，应将成品礼盒作为装箱对象测量，并在报价中分清两层。
review: State units per carton, full packed weight, dimensions and destination. Review partitions, void space, bottom and top sealing, and the expected stacking conditions. Confirm board grade and test plan from that information rather than appearance.
说明每箱数量、装箱总重、尺寸及目的地。检查隔板、空隙、上下封箱和预期堆码条件，依据这些信息确认纸板等级与测试方案，而不是凭外观判断。

MTT-B0110.seoTitle: Custom Reed Diffuser Paper Bag | Twisted Handles
MTT-B0110.seoDescription: Printed kraft shopping bag for a boxed reed diffuser, with twisted-paper handles and optional tissue. Review bag dimensions, reinforcement and loaded carrying.
answer: A printed kraft shopping bag with twisted-paper handles for carrying a boxed reed diffuser. Side gussets and a folded bottom define the bag shape; tissue can be specified separately.
印刷牛皮纸手提袋配扭绳纸提手，用于携带已包装的香薰产品；袋侧风琴位与折底形成袋体，薄页纸可另外选配。
selection: Choose this as the retail carrying layer of a coordinated set. It does not replace a bottle support, leak-control arrangement or parcel carton. Match the bag to the finished outer box, not just to the glass bottle.
适合作为整套包装的零售携带层，不能替代瓶器支撑、防漏安排或快递外箱。袋子应按成品外盒选配，而非只按玻璃瓶尺寸。
review: Specify bag width × side gusset × height, the boxed product size, reed length if separate, and loaded weight. Test insertion, removal, handle attachment and base integrity with the full set. Confirm tissue, card and print colours together.
袋尺寸按袋宽 × 侧宽 × 袋高标注，并提供成品盒尺寸、单独放置时的藤条长度和装载重量。整套装入后检查取放、提手连接和底部完整性，一起确认薄页纸、卡片与印色。

MTT-R1201.seoTitle: Custom Perfume duo Fold-Flat Gift Box | MTT
MTT-R1201.seoDescription: Custom perfume duo collapsible rigid packaging in cobalt blue and orange. See magnetic closure, fitted insert, paper finish and flat-pack view. Request a sample.
answer: A one-piece magnetic rigid presentation box for two perfume bottles, with two bottle positions and card space. The insert is removable so the empty shell can be supplied flat before assembly.
为双瓶香水配置的一体式磁吸硬盒，带双瓶定位与卡片位。内托可取出，空盒壳可在组装前折平。
selection: Choose this when a connected lid and flat delivery are useful. Compare a fixed rigid box if permanent assembly is preferred. Flat-pack savings depend on the final carton layout and separately packed inserts.
需要一体连接盒盖和折平交付时可选。若希望永久成型，可比较固定硬盒。节省空间取决于最终装箱方式及内托单独包装体积。
review: Confirm product height, insert removal, corner fixing, hinge clearance and magnetic alignment. Confirm whether the selected corner fixing permits repeat folding; review the full shipping pack separately. Provide actual filled product dimensions and weight, quantity and destination.
确认产品高度、内托取放、四角固定、折位间隙及磁吸对位。确认所选四角固定方式是否允许重复折叠，并单独审核完整运输包装。 提供实际装满后的产品尺寸、重量、数量和目的地。

MTT-R1202.seoDescription: Custom travel fragrance set collapsible rigid packaging in coral and ivory. See magnetic closure, fitted insert, paper finish and flat-pack view. Request a sample.
answer: A one-piece magnetic rigid presentation box for four travel perfume vials, with four vial channels and card space. The insert is removable so the empty shell can be supplied flat before assembly.
为四支便携香水配置的一体式磁吸硬盒，带四支香水槽与卡片位。内托可取出，空盒壳可在组装前折平。
selection: Choose this when a connected lid and flat delivery are useful. Compare a fixed rigid box if permanent assembly is preferred. Flat-pack savings depend on the final carton layout and separately packed inserts.
需要一体连接盒盖和折平交付时可选。若希望永久成型，可比较固定硬盒。节省空间取决于最终装箱方式及内托单独包装体积。
review: Confirm product height, insert removal, corner fixing, hinge clearance and magnetic alignment. Confirm whether the selected corner fixing permits repeat folding; review the full shipping pack separately. Provide actual filled product dimensions and weight, quantity and destination.

MTT-R1203.seoDescription: Custom skincare ritual collapsible rigid packaging in lilac and lime. See magnetic closure, fitted insert, paper finish and flat-pack view. Request a sample.
answer: A one-piece magnetic rigid presentation box for cream jar and serum bottle, with separate cream-jar and serum positions. The insert is removable so the empty shell can be supplied flat before assembly.
为面霜罐与精华瓶配置的一体式磁吸硬盒，带面霜罐与精华瓶分区。内托可取出，空盒壳可在组装前折平。

MTT-R1204.seoDescription: Custom makeup launch kit collapsible rigid packaging in fuchsia and midnight blue. See magnetic closure, fitted insert, paper finish and flat-pack view. Request a sample.
answer: A one-piece magnetic rigid presentation box for lipstick tubes and compact palette, with two lipstick positions and a compact recess. The insert is removable so the empty shell can be supplied flat before assembly.
为唇膏与粉盒配置的一体式磁吸硬盒，带两支唇膏与粉盒定位。内托可取出，空盒壳可在组装前折平。
selection: Choose this when a connected lid and flat delivery are useful. Compare a fixed rigid box if permanent assembly is preferred. Flat-pack savings depend on the final carton layout and separately packed inserts.

MTT-R1205.seoDescription: Custom tea tin pairing collapsible rigid packaging in emerald and cream. See magnetic closure, fitted insert, paper finish and flat-pack view. Request a sample.
answer: A one-piece magnetic rigid presentation box for two closed tea tins, with two tea-tin positions. The insert is removable so the empty shell can be supplied flat before assembly.
